A quick reminder about Rule 8 from the server rules: there can be times when we will step in to riff and improv on the things that catch our attention. There will be plenty of time to do what we call “Invitationals.” Invitationals are enacted when a player or a DM wants to follow through on an improv story line. They can be requested by anyone, but are fulfilled only as time and DM interest allows.

Please remember that while for players this can feel like a big open sandbox game, the things in it that you are interacting with are people who donate their time. Its a big job that is as taxing as it is rewarding. Talk to you DMs about what you would like to accomplish in down time and invitationals. And when it works for them to help generate the hours and hours of content we provide (for free and on top of your jobs, lives and everything else.) We love you. Most of the DMs have not endured this gauntlet before. Trust me, trying to put this event on is one of the most challenging things a dm will ever do.  Be patient courteous and kind to all of our volunteers. 
If a dm is running combat in voice, they might ask to keep mics closed when running. A very good habit to be in, is to pre type your action before your turn. Combat is long. You might have 20-30 minutes between rounds. Please do your best not to take extra time on your turn. It is a matter of kindness to your dms and courtesy to you fellow players. Remember to thank your mods, and listen to them when they mod combat and loot drops. Thanks
-Radar.
The ley power is almost back to normal in ferrytown. By 6:00 server time, all the parks will be wholly as they once were, before things went to shit last week.

Ah, meta gaming. That age old pastime of players. To the experienced player, it is the sharing of tricks of the trade and the fear of sub optimal playing. An experienced player will also relish the value of making intentionally unreliable or intentionally against the grain choices for role play reasons. 

But to the newer player, there comes a perceived pressure when their decisions are sub optimal.  Wisdom is in being gentle enough with your opinions about how they should play, be it mechanics or social decisions. 

Personally, I often have a hard time reading social cues. And even then, lots of us have been playing together for years and ride that wave of emphatic group opinion. 
The number of neurodivergent players on the server is above half. And that is something to consider when it comes to interplay discussions about the how tos of role playing.

Meta gaming and theory crafting about the plot is some of the most gratifying things a dm can read. But its is an acquired rhythm that becomes available as your become more experienced. There are lots of kick ass players on this server. There are also lots of people who love to protect and nurture those who could use it among us. 

Remember server rule 1.
If you don't remember it, please take the time to reread it today.

The air shifts as heat can be felt throughout Empire city.  The ground shakes.  Anyone looking towards Hampstead sees a city aflame, with explosions happening everywhere.  Atop the highest hill, a castle, known as King George III Airship Port blows up.  The ships are safe, and the ones controlled by redcoats leave the area.  Foundations are ruined throughout the Borough, the city is covered in soot.  Among the list of the dead citizens, that fought to save the city , Aper Filos's body is found dead with a ring of readcoats torn apart, silver arrows sticking out of his hide.  A large dead mimic is found near the destroyed ordinary, half eaten hell wasps litter the area around it.  Mr Kern was saved due to efforts by Bones.  Nearly every building has been destroyed, and many many people are dead.

The streets are rubble, fractured, and thus moving in our our of Hampstead will take an extra hour unless you can fly above
The Ordinary is destroyed, caved into its basement, and the walls fractured, and thus, Essance can no longer be bought or sold
The Boars head blew up, and thus there are no longer supplies anywhere to be bought
There are no longer alleyways, gallows.... everything is splintered, fractured, and covered in soot

Through great work from the players, The sewers and Gazette were saved.  The number of people needing places to live, and ships needing a new dock, is incalculable.

The fog is gone.  All Damnations, all levels of Damnations is now gone.  You are no longer corrupted.

But your minds are free, your spirit unbroken.  Success has never come with such a cost

@everyone , Just so you know a few channels have been recently created as the roleplay on the server winds down.

<#880340896267243530> is a place for players (including mods) to share thoughts on the season.  Think of it as a "this season nostalgia" channel with a forum for you to give some added constructive ideas.

<#879133139463700480> This is where you post your epilogue.  If it helps with group epilogues and such, feel free to make threads (or just make a thread if you wish)

<#880417697018548274> is a place where, DMs that sign up, can give details and answer questions for s4.  Missed plots, dropped threads, just that nagging question you have had all season.... this is where we can give you some Bluray Bonus Materials.

Its likely sometime Friday, or possibly Saturday, all the RP channels will be locked.  That said, we don't remove people from the servers so you all can go back and re-read everything.  These two days are for you to have a little denouement before your epilogues.

With all that said I want to thank you all.  Really, its been a great time for me, and I hope it is for you.  Take some time off, get some sleep.... I know we all need it.  The work for s5 has already started.

P.S. Give Radar some time off to sleep today.  Once he is back online, you can continue to offer help for s5 if he hasn't gotten to you yet.
